item.title: Presentation: Wrangling Telemetry at Scale: A Guide to Self-Hosted Observability
item.description: Colin Douch shares battle-tested strategies for building and scaling self-hosted observability stacks. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Our Response To The eMudhra Key Disclosure Incident
item.description: How the Go team responded to the eMudhra certificate compromise with our first-ever URGENT track security release. (2 sources: goblog, lobsters)

item.title: Announcing the Workload Conformance Working Group
item.description: We are excited to announce that the Kubernetes community now has a Workload Conformance Working Group . The working group is writing a shared standard for how workloads behave at runtime on Kubernetes. (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.description: A lot of people are leaving software engineering because agent-based workflows killed their joy. I don't have that problem; I never liked the job in the first place. (1 source: sreweekly)
